com.sun.org.apache.bcel.internal.generic

类 InstructionFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.org.apache.bcel.internal.generic.InstructionFactory
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    InstructionConstants, Serializable

    public class InstructionFactory
extends Object
implements InstructionConstants, Serializable
    Instances of this class may be used, e.g., to generate typed versions of instructions. Its main purpose is to be used as the byte code generating backend of a compiler. You can subclass it to add your own create methods.
    作者:
    M. Dahm
    另请参阅:
    Constants, 序列化表格
